name: PreOrders for WooCommerce – PreCart
author: tasin07

sections.description:
PreCart is a plugin that enables store owners to offer pre-order functionality for products. Customers can reserve upcoming or out-of-stock items, and you can manage pre-orders with flexible payment options, release date scheduling, and automated notifications.

Key Features:
– Enable pre-orders for individual products or product variations.
– Set pre-order availability dates and deadlines.
– Display pre-order badge and release date on product pages.
– Manage pre-order limits and inventory allocation.
– Compatible with all WooCommerce payment gateways.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the precart folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Pre-Order to configure the plugin.
  4. Enable pre-orders for individual products from the product edit page.

short_description: Allow customers to pre-order products on your WooCommerce store with ease. Manage pre-orders, set release dates, and accept payments seamlessly.
